title: Nostalgic Vietnamese Pork Bun Cha
description: This dish features umami flavors and a shattering texture, with a focus on ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, making it a unique and nostalgic Vietnamese experience.
instructions: Grill the pork shoulder over medium heat until it is nicely charred.
In a large bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, and red pepper flakes.
Add the sliced pork to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
Assemble the dish by placing the noodles on a plate, topping with the marinated pork, lettuce, mint, and pickled carrots.
Drizzle the remaining marinade over the top of the dish.
Reduce the amount of red pepper flakes if you prefer a milder flavor.
Garnish with additional mint and lettuce if desired.
